_comment: Authoritative Atlas turret weapon tuning shared by server combat and client presentation. Changing any value is a gameplay change: bump WireCodec.BUILD and ship a matching hosted server release. Barrel tables are keyed by barrel count (1 single, 2 twin, 4 quad); interval is seconds between shots (cannon: reload after the volley), heat is shared heat per shot, jolt is hull velocity change (m/s) per shot at the muzzle and rock is the rocking impulse (rad/s) across the shot.

servo._comment: Traverse/elevation servo rates (rad/s), cannon volley spacing (s), and the hull tilt (rad) beyond which firing adds no further rock, so volleys can never flip the machine.

flamer._comment: Cone half-angle in radians; damage is per pulse to every visible enemy inside the cone.

tesla._comment: Seek cone half-angle (rad) for the primary arc; the chain jumps chain_reach metres for chain_share of the damage.

railgun._comment: Hold to charge for charge_seconds while adding charge_heat_per_second, release a full charge; the slug pierces a second target for pierce_share. A slug that destroys what it strikes keeps overpenetration_retain of the energy it did not spend and flies on at that strength, through up to max_penetrations bodies (#72). interval is the reload after a shot.

harpoon._comment: Barbed bolt on a cable. A hit tethers the target; holding the trigger winches it toward the muzzle with up to pull_acceleration (m/s^2 scaled by the target's heft), driving the line in at reel_speed (m/s) and easing off over the last metres until it is within min_length metres, adding reel_heat_per_second. reaction_share of the pull drags the shooter. The tether snaps beyond max_length, when static geometry blocks the line, or after max_seconds. damage is the bolt's impact; interval is the reload after a miss or a cut.

mortar._comment: Lobbed shell: muzzle_speed (m/s) under shell_gravity (m/s^2) from elevations between min_elevation (rad) and the audited 80-degree stop, so range falls as elevation rises. damage hits at the blast centre and falls to blast_edge_share at blast_radius metres; walls shield. knock pushes outward and up. range bounds the simulated flight path.
